title: mapcn — add stunning maps to your web apps with just one command setup  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Map CN adds stunning maps to your web apps with just one command setup. Built on Map LiGGL, Map CN gives you full access to mapping features right out of the box. It's all ready to go with sensible defaults that work perfectly for any project. It's theme aware, so it automatically adapts to light and dark modes. It lets you add markers and tool tips, plus draw roots and paths on your maps.
